messages.text:
The core implementation path is now clear: this benchmark cares about exact process behavior for a limited xsv command surface, so the port should be a real CSV CLI rather than a wrapper around the reference binary.

I’m adding a compact Python implementation plus the required build wrapper; the main risk is Rust/docopt-style error text, so I’ll validate with live differential samples after the first runnable version.

commands.commandLine:
{"command":"sh ./compile.sh; $ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .tura/tmp | Out-Null; @'
h1,h2,h3
a,2,z
b,1,y
a,3,x
'@ | Set-Content -NoNewline .tura/tmp/in.csv; $cmds=@('headers .tura/tmp/in.csv','count .tura/tmp/in.csv','select h2,h1 .tura/tmp/in.csv','slice -s 1 -l 1 .tura/tmp/in.csv','search a .tura/tmp/in.csv','sort -s h2 .tura/tmp/in.csv','fmt -t `t .tura/tmp/in.csv','stats --everything .tura/tmp/in.csv','frequency --limit 0 .tura/tmp/in.csv','table .tura/tmp/in.csv'); foreach($c in $cmds){ $args=$c -split ' '; & $ref @args > .tura/tmp/ref.out 2> .tura/tmp/ref.err; $rs=$LASTEXITCODE; & .\executable.cmd @args > .tura/tmp/new.out 2> .tura/tmp/new.err; $ns=$LASTEXITCODE; if($rs -ne $ns -or (Get-FileHash .tura/tmp/ref.out).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash .tura/tmp/new.out).Hash -or (Get-FileHash .tura/tmp/ref.err).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash .tura/tmp/new.err).Hash){ Write-Output "DIFF $c ref=$rs new=$ns"; Write-Output '--- ref out'; Get-Content .tura/tmp/ref.out; Write-Output '--- new out'; Get-Content .tura/tmp/new.out; Write-Output '--- ref err'; Get-Content .tura/tmp/ref.err; Write-Output '--- new err'; Get-Content .tura/tmp/new.err; exit 1 }}; Write-Output 'smoke differential passed'","workdir":"C:\Users\liuliu\Documents\tura_workspace\target\project-rebuild-source-port\r-d573c29e47\xsv\tura-direct-3\workspace","timeout_ms":30000}
